new_defect_types.name: tool_output_mismatch
new_defect_types.description: The effect produced by an instrument does not match the instrument's contents or state (white-cream piping bag writes brown chocolate lines; pen colour vs ink).
examples: orig574/qwen_image_2p1_nope: white cream bag, all letters brown chocolate
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A12 cause->effect examples are environmental physics; a VLM does not check tool contents vs produced marks.

new_defect_types.name: anthropomorphic_end_effector
new_defect_types.description: Human body parts (gloved hand, fingers) grafted onto machines/robots, or robots using human hand tools as if they were people.
examples: phi93/flux3_klein_base: black gloved hand at ABB wrist holds gravity spray gun
phi93/krea2_turbo: grey gloved hand at robot wrist grips pistol gun
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A05 is about bodies, A10 about machines working; the hybrid human-machine part is in neither's examples.

new_defect_types.name: screen_viewpoint_logic
new_defect_types.description: Content shown on a screen/feed/mirror contradicts its stated source (an excavator's forward camera showing the whole excavator in third person).
examples: phi338/fibo2_dev, flux3_klein, flux3_klein_base, ideogram4_nf4, krea2_turbo, qwen x2: monitor shows whole excavator from outside
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B03/B06 check interactions and placement, not logical consistency of depicted media.

new_defect_types.name: invented_slogan_flooding
new_defect_types.description: Generator fills posters, mugs, hats, vests, notebooks with unrequested motivational/brand slogans, turning set dressing into text-heavy template.
examples: phi338/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high: 'REAL SITES REAL PROGRESS', 'SAFER CLEANER STRONGER', 'BUILD SMARTER TOGETHER', 'PLAN OPERATE IMPROVE'
orig339/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst: 'HUMANITY A HIGHER VERSION'
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B04 only flags prompt words written as text; B07 lists brick walls/plants as template dressing but not invented slogans; A03 only checks if text is gibberish, and these are correctly spelled.

new_defect_types.name: semantic_text_error
new_defect_types.description: Legible, correctly spelled technical text that is nonsensical in context (non-existent package codes, mismatched part specs).
examples: phi216/gemini_3_1_flash_image: 'U4 QFN16 0605'
phi216/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high: 'Murata 0605 100nF'

new_defect_types.name: decal_orientation_mismatch
new_defect_types.description: Printed text/logo stays upright to the viewer although the object it is printed on is tipped or rotated.
examples: orig339/qwen_image_2p1_pe: toppled mug with horizontally upright Japanese text
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A15 mentions decals ignoring curvature only, not object pose.

new_defect_types.name: mixed_altitude_viewpoint
new_defect_types.description: Foreground shot from ground level combined with a background seen from orbit/altitude (planet limb behind beach surf).
examples: orig458/krea2_turbo: beach waves running up to curved Earth limb
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A11 is phrased as line convergence/overlap ordering.

rubric_issues.problem: Explicit exclusions of a body part ('with no tail') are routinely violated (7/12 models) and it is unclear whether to log B02, B03 or B07.
examples: orig96/gemini, ideogram, krea, qwen x2, fibo: tail present
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: State in B07 (or new B09 negation) that any explicitly excluded object, part or attribute that is present is major when on the focal subject.

rubric_issues.problem: Standard-design objects (traffic signs) rendered with wrong canonical shape while text is correct; or hybrid of two sign designs.
examples: phi452: 5 models draw a yellow diamond YIELD; sunburst draws red yield triangle inside diamond
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add: regulatory signs, flags, instruments must have the canonical shape for the stated type; a merged design of two standards is A10.

rubric_issues.problem: Dashcam OSD timestamp/speed bar is a requested-by-implication overlay ('dashcam view'), and could be over-flagged as subtitle bar.
examples: phi452/gemini_3_1_flash_image: '2023-10-27 15:42:09 GMT 58 MPH'
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Overlays native to a requested capture device (dashcam OSD, CCTV timestamp, viewfinder HUD) are not A16.

rubric_issues.problem: Does not mention instrument contents vs produced marks, or self-luminous-looking passive objects under flat light.
examples: orig574/qwen_image_2p1_nope brown lines from white cream
phi452/qwen_image_2p1_nope sign glowing like a lightbox under overcast
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add examples: 'white icing bag makes white lines', 'non-emissive sign does not glow under overcast'.

false_positive_traps.description: Text written by a subject facing the camera appears upside-down/mirrored to the viewer; this is physically correct and should be transcribed after rotating, not flagged.
examples: orig574/gemini_3_1_flash_image cake text reads from chef's side

false_positive_traps.description: Reflections of text on glossy surfaces are correctly mirrored and should not count as A03 mirrored characters.
examples: phi452/gemini_3_1_flash_image hood reflection of YIELD sign reads mirrored

false_positive_traps.description: Dashcam timestamp/speed overlay when a dashcam view is requested is genre-appropriate, not A16.
examples: phi452/gemini_3_1_flash_image

false_positive_traps.description: Robot covered in a protective paint suit looks like a draped cloth blob but is realistic paint-booth practice.
examples: phi93/gpt_image_2_quality_high

false_positive_traps.description: Prompt-requested colour that contradicts modern convention (yellow YIELD sign = pre-1971 US) should not be flagged; only the shape error counts.
